levels.surface: أبو صالح عبد الله بن صالح

notes: «بهذا الحديث» refers to the saying, not to a chain, so it is not written as a link
«وروى مالك، هذا الحديث» right after the first chain is another isnad for the same saying: its own group
the third group comes from the compiler's quotation «قال محمد وقد روي عن مالك أيضا» (al-Bukhari, not written): a remark naming a different transmitter for the same saying, variant (rule 4)
«الصحيح حديث الزهري عن سالم عن أبيه» is a judgement on versions, not a route; left out. «بينما عمر بن الخطاب يخطب» describes Umar's action: not a link (rule 6)
